setup.subtitle: Forza Horizon 2 runs on PC through Azimuth, by Almost There Games. Infinity needs Azimuth 0.9.10 with the Infinity hook.

setup.summary_missing: Let's get Azimuth set up. Follow the steps below.

setup.summary_ready: Azimuth is ready to play online.

setup.step1: 1. Download Azimuth {version} (azimuth-windows.zip) from its official page on itch.io. Use only this page: copies elsewhere may be modified.
setup.step2: 2. Extract the zip into a new, empty folder (for example C:\Games\Azimuth). Don't extract it over an existing Azimuth folder: it would replace the Infinity hook.
setup.step3: 3. Run azimuth.exe once and select your Forza Horizon 2 game folder: the Xbox One version {game}, the folder with era.vbi, Mount and EmbeddedXvd. Storm Island and Fast & Furious are added on Azimuth's Game page.
setup.step4: 4. Come back here and press "Choose the Azimuth folder…" (or "Check again"). Infinity remembers it.
setup.disclaimer: Infinity doesn't include or download Forza Horizon 2 or Azimuth files: use your own copy of the game. Azimuth is an independent project by Almost There Games, not affiliated with Microsoft, Xbox or Playground Games.

bugs.title: Found a bug?
bugs.intro: Tell us what happened. Clear reports help us fix problems and keep everyone driving.
bugs.step1_body: Open our GitHub issue tracker and search for the problem. If someone has already reported it, add useful details to that issue.
bugs.step2_body: Sign in to GitHub, select New issue, and follow any available template. Include a short title, steps to reproduce, what you expected, and what actually happened.
bugs.step3_body: Add your launcher version, Windows or Proton version, and screenshots if they help. Remove personal information and credentials. Never attach passwords, tokens, account files, saves, or game files.

crash.title: Azimuth closed unexpectedly
crash.intro: You can send private metadata to help Infinity investigate, or copy a diagnostic report for support. Nothing is uploaded without your permission.
crash.roster_note: Snapshot from {time}; membership may have changed before the crash.
crash.roster_missing: World membership could not be confirmed locally. The service verifies available session history.
crash.blame_unknown: Cause not established. Being in the world or sending the last packet does not identify an offender.
crash.metadata_privacy: The service receives diagnostic codes, build versions and session/world IDs. It resolves participants from its own records. Names, local paths, tokens, chat, raw packets and memory are excluded. Reports support human review; they do not automatically freeze accounts.
crash.metadata_consent: I agree to send diagnostic metadata only to Infinity.
crash.dump_privacy: A local memory dump is available (up to 16 MiB). It may contain sensitive process memory. Saving it creates a file on your computer; the launcher will not upload it.
crash.no_dump: No matching dump is available. You can still send the diagnostic report.
crash.sent: Metadata received for human review. No memory was uploaded and no automatic penalty was applied.
crash.send_failed: Sending did not complete. The local report is kept. You can explicitly retry or copy it for support; an accepted metadata report will not be duplicated.
crash.local_failed: The local copy could not be removed.
crash.frozen: Online access is temporarily frozen for security review. Sign-in and support remain available.
crash.dumps_disabled: Infinity does not receive memory dumps in this phase. Only a separately consented metadata report can be sent.
crash.legacy_action: This pending action uses an earlier report format. Its consent and request will not be reused. Select the metadata consent and Send metadata only to create a separate action; no attachment will be sent.
crash.exported: Diagnostic copied or saved locally. Nothing was uploaded.
crash.export_failed: The diagnostic could not be copied or saved. The original local report is kept.
crash.private_support_help: Share the copied diagnostic with support. Send a memory dump only when requested, in the private support space identified by moderators. Never post a dump in a public channel.
crash.private_support_unset: No support destination is configured. Keep the diagnostic locally until a moderator identifies the private support space; never post a dump publicly.
crash.manual_dump_consent: I understand that the dump may contain sensitive information and choose to save a copy for manual private support.
community.contribution: Community participation is essential to the stability of our online services and a respectful playing environment. Reporting technical issues and inappropriate conduct helps our team investigate and take responsible action. Sending a report is voluntary.

integrity.not_required: Game file checks apply only to Infinity Supporter Hardcore profiles. This profile plays online without them.
integrity.cached: Previous verification remembered. We will confirm the files with the server before starting online play.
connection.snapshot: NAT, IPv6 and public address describe the current host relay when available. They are not measured by the HTTP request. This report does not guarantee lobby connectivity.

integrity.help: If modifications or an incomplete check prevent online play, share the copied diagnostic with our Discord support team for help. A mismatch does not establish misconduct.
integrity.compatible: The selected critical files match the server's compatibility reference.
integrity.incompatible: Some selected critical files differ from the server's compatibility reference. Online worlds are unavailable. Verify the installation or contact support for help.
integrity.inconclusive: We could not verify all selected critical files. Online worlds remain unavailable. Retry the check or contact support.
integrity.policy_unavailable: The server's compatibility check is unavailable. Try again before playing online.

mods.required_unavailable: {mod} is required to play with Infinity but can't be installed right now. Open Mods to review it.
integrity.mediaoverride: Hardcore needs the game's media overrides to hold only files of your enabled mods that don't affect multiplayer. Remove or restore these files, then play again: {paths}
mods.runtime_ended: Your selected mods failed to start, so Infinity closed the game. Open Mods to review them, or disable them to play without mods.
mods.prepare_failed: Mods could not be prepared for this launch. Open Mods, or disable the mods to play without them.
mods.error.game_running: Close the game before changing mods.
mods.error.drift: Files changed outside the launcher. Use Accept current files or Disable, keep current files.
mods.error.dependency: Check this mod's dependencies: they must be installed, enabled and set as required, and mods that depend on it must be disabled first.
mods.error.conflict: Another mod or an existing file conflicts with this mod.
mods.error.recovery: An interrupted mod operation needs a decision. Use Recover, or Keep current files and close it.
mods.error.linked: Linked folders inside the game or Azimuth folders are not supported for mods.
mods.error.protected: This mod would change a file the launcher protects.
mods.error.digest: A downloaded or backed-up file did not match its expected hash. Nothing was changed.
mods.error.download: The mod could not be downloaded from its official source.
mods.error.unsupported: This mod needs capabilities this launcher does not support yet.
mods.error.busy: Another launcher window is changing mods. Try again when it finishes.
mods.error.locked: This setting is locked by Infinity.
mods.error.catalog: The mod catalog could not be verified.
mods.error.settings: A setting value is not valid. Check numbers and choices.
mods.error.relink: This installation's records belong to another folder. Use Link the moved installation.
mods.hardcore_refused: Hardcore profiles can't use mods that affect multiplayer: {mods}. Disable them or play a Noob profile.
mods.hardcore_unavailable: Unavailable on this Hardcore profile: this mod affects multiplayer.
mods.error.hardcore: Hardcore profiles can't enable mods that affect multiplayer. Play a Noob profile to use this mod.
mods.error.unconfirmed: Confirm this custom mod first: it isn't reviewed by Infinity.
mods.data_sql_runtime: Needs the Infinity mod runtime with data-mod support (database changes), which this launcher doesn't have yet.
mods.error.runtime_required: This mod changes the game database and needs the Infinity mod runtime with data-mod support, which this launcher doesn't have yet.
mods.error.database_base: Another enabled mod already replaces the game database. Only one car pack that replaces the database can be on at a time.
mods.error.database_base_named: {mod} already replaces the game database. Only one car pack that replaces the database can be on at a time: disable it first.
mods.custom_confirm_text: This mod is not reviewed by Infinity. It comes from files you placed in the custom mods folder; Infinity only checks that they match its manifest before installing them, with backups of anything they replace. It can break your game or your saves, and it marks your online lobbies as modded: only players with the identical pack can join. Continue only if you trust where it came from. Each new version of the mod asks again.
mods.custom_executable: It contains executable code, which runs with your game.
mods.custom_problems: {count} custom mod folders could not be read
mods.custom_folder_failed: The custom mods folder could not be opened. Its path is shown above.
mods.url_title: Add a custom mod from a URL
mods.url_hint: Paste an HTTPS link to a ZIP holding one custom mod (an infinity-mod.json with a custom. id, plus its files/ and database/ folders). Infinity checks every file and creates the mod's folder for you; you still confirm the mod on its card before installing.
mods.url_added: {mod} was added to your custom mods. Review and confirm it on its card to install.
mods.url_replaced: {mod} was updated. The previous folder was kept in mods/custom/.replaced.
mods.url_unchanged: {mod} is already in your custom mods with these exact files.
mods.progress.url_verify: Finding the manifest and checking every file…
mods.error.url_download: The ZIP could not be downloaded. Check that the link is HTTPS and points straight at the file.
mods.error.archive: The download is not a usable mod ZIP: it is damaged, too large, or misses a file its manifest lists.
mods.error.archive_manifest: The ZIP needs exactly one valid custom mod infinity-mod.json (an id starting with custom.).
mods.url_incompatible_title: This mod isn't compatible with Infinity
mods.error.archive_no_manifest: This ZIP has no infinity-mod.json, so Infinity can't install it. Ask the modder to adapt the mod to the Infinity mod schema: {url}
mods.error.custom_full: The custom mods folder already holds the most mods it can list. Remove one before adding another.
mods.error.external_files: Some of this mod's files from your own copy are missing or different, or haven't been checked yet. Open Set up on its card and choose your copy again.
mods.runtime_catalog_needed: Native mods need the Infinity mod runtime, which comes from the mod catalog, and the catalog couldn't be reached. Check your connection and try again, or disable them on Mods to play online.
mods.error.runtime_missing: This mod needs the Infinity mod runtime, and none could be installed. Check your connection and the catalog, then try again.
mods.runtime_with_mod: Not installed · installs the Infinity mod runtime with it
external.card_status: You need your own copy of {hint}. Infinity checks it and copies what it needs; the pack itself is never downloaded.
external.title: Set up {mod}
external.intro: This mod uses files from your own copy. Choose where it is for each item below: the folder itself, any folder above it, or its ZIP. Infinity finds and checks every file, then copies what it needs.
external.nothing_found: None of this mod's files are in the folder or file you chose. Choose your copy of the pack.
external.notice: Uses files from your own copy of {hint}. This content isn't made or checked by Infinity, and online lobbies only match players with the identical pack.
external.recheck: Check files again or choose another copy…
external.empty_folder: No folders or ZIP files here.
external.reason.source_gone: the folder or file is no longer there (a removed SD card or USB drive?).
external.reason.source_too_large: it holds too many files to search. Choose a folder closer to the pack, such as its own folder.
external.reason.source_not_zip: that file isn't a readable ZIP.
external.kept: {count} unchanged files kept from your earlier copy.
external.stored_damaged: {count} copied files no longer match. Choose your copy of the pack again.
external.game_folder: This mod adds files to the game. Choose the game folder first (the folder with Mount inside, or Mount itself).
mods.error.game_folder: This mod adds files to the game, and no game folder is chosen yet. Choose it with Game folder (Configure → Game integrity), then try again.
external.replaces:
This replaces {count} files already in that folder. They are backed up and come back when you disable or uninstall the mod. Check it's the right game folder:
{files}
catalog.title: Mod catalog
catalog.unofficial_short: Unofficial catalog: not verified by Infinity.
catalog.unofficial_warning: You're using an unofficial, unverified mod catalog ({url}). Infinity doesn't review what it lists: its mods, including ones that run code with your game or change settings Infinity normally locks, come from whoever runs that catalog. Each download is still checked against the hash the catalog lists. Use it only if you trust its source.
catalog.hint: Use a different catalog: paste the HTTPS address of a catalog JSON file. You can return to the official catalog at any time.
catalog.invalid: Enter an HTTPS address (no port, no #fragment).
catalog.save_failed: The catalog choice could not be saved. Check folder access and try again.
catalog.switched_custom: Now using the unofficial catalog. Its mods aren't verified by Infinity.
catalog.switched_official: Back on Infinity's official mod catalog.
catalog.badge_native: Unofficial catalog · unverified · runs code with your game
